topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens by introducing the topic of cancer therapy and stating the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and resistance mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the principles, clinical limitations, and drug resistance mechanisms associated with conventional treatment modalities like surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit cancer-specific biological vulnerabilities, including hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint loss, and defective DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the rationale, biochemical mechanisms, and resistance pathways associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates are designed to target cancer cell surface antigens and deliver cytotoxic payloads.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and immunotherapy modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the role of natural immune surveillance and detail diverse immunotherapy platforms designed to mobilize T cells against tumors.

topics.label: Overarching challenges, mortality trends, and future paradigms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize current hurdles in oncology, evaluate historical progress in cancer survival, and consider future directions in disease management.

topics.label: Closing reflection on childhood leukemia and trial dilemmas
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture concludes with a closing case study on pediatric leukemia survival that highlights the ethical challenges of trialing new therapies against effective existing regimens.
